senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to stand still,] to be astonished; to be waste.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:10">Tosef. Sot. XV, 10</cite> <he>ונמצא ישראל ש׳ וזרע וכ׳</he> and as a consequence Israel will be laid waste, and the seed of Abraham cease.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 2:4:5">Y. Bets. II, 61ᶜ</cite> top <he>פעם … ומצא אותה שׁוֹמֶמֶת</he> once he entered the Temple court and found it deserted; <he>יָשֹׁמּוּ בתיהם … שׁהֵשֵׁימּוּ וכ׳</he> (or <he>יִשַּׁמּוּ</he>) deserted be the homes of those who caused the house of our God to be laid waste; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:3:5">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>שׁהֵישַׁמּוּ</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:5">Cant. R. to V, 5</cite> <he>ראה המדינה שוממת</he> he (Cyrus) saw that the country was ruined.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:3:12">Y. Ber. IV, 8ᵃ</cite> <he>ההרוסה והשׁוֹמֵמָה</he> destroyed and deserted.

<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 3:3">Meg. III, 3</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 26:31">Lev. XXVI, 31</cite>) <he>קדושתן … שׁוֹמֵמִין</he> (Y. ed. <he>שׁוֹמֵימִין</he>) they remain holy, even when they lie in ruins. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1) <he>שָׁמְמָה עלי נפשי</he> my soul within me is waste (mourns); a. fr.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 959:31">Yalk. Prov. 959</cite> <he>אם זכה משמחו ואם לאו מְשַׁמְּמוֹ</he> if a man is good, it (dreaming of wine) means joy to him, if not, it means confounding.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M02832"><he>מְשׁוּמָּם</he></cite>; f. <he>מְשׁוּמֶּמֶת</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 7:10">Tosef. Keth. VII, 10</cite> <he>מש׳ היא</he> (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="U01669"><he>שעמומית</he></cite>) she (my daughter) is confused in her mind; v. <cite ref="U01671"><he>שִׁעֲמֵם</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01669"><he>שַׁעֲמוּמִית</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> (play on <he>אנשי השם</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 4:4">Gen. IV, 4</cite>) <he>שׁהֵשִׁימּוּ את העולם ושהוּשַׁמּוּ … שׁיִשּׁוֹם</he> they confounded the world, and they were ruined (driven) out of the world, and caused the world to be laid waste. Y. Bets. l. c.; Y. Ḥag. l. c., v. supra.

senses.gloss: , Hof. הוּשַׁם to be laid waste, ruined. Gen. R. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:13:4">Cant. R. to II, 13</cite> <he>והגבלן יִשּׁוֹם</he>, v. <cite ref="C00113"><he>גַּבְלָן</he></cite>. Y. Bets. l. c.; Y. Ḥag. l. c., v. supra.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4">Gen. R. s. 4</cite>, end (expl. <he>ש̇מ̇י̇ם̇</he>) <he>שהבריות מִשְׁתּוֹמְמִים … של אש̇ הן של מ̇י̇ם̇ הן</he> men wonder at them, (asking) are they of fire? are they of water?
<cite ref="Kiddushin 66a:12">Kidd. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>והיה העולם מִשְׁתּוֹמֵם וכ׳</he> and the (Jewish) world was ruined (demoralized), until Simon b. Sh. came and restored the Law &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 33a:3">Sabb. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>והדרכים מִשְׁתּוֹמְמִין</he> and the roads are desolate; a. e.
